worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.summary: Spits a glob of gooey silk at one target; on a hit it wraps the target in a cocoon, and every further hit on the same target adds a layer that lasts longer and slows it further, fully pinning it at three or more layers. The user may walk away, but any flame burns the whole web away at once.
worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.use.0: Wrap a fleeing target layer by layer for allies to finish
worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.use.1: Ensnare a high-mobility target so it cannot break away
worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.use.2: Follow up behind an ally's fire so the target must cut the silk first
The first layer holds the target for about %1$s; each further layer adds %2$s, up to %3$s layers.
Each layer removes about %1$s of the target's navigation speed, fully pinning it at three or more layers.
The silk flies at about %1$s blocks per tick, with a %2$s block hit radius and up to %3$s blocks of range.
Wind-up %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s. Any Fire-type damage or being on fire burns the whole web away at once.
worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.option.on: Thick cocoon: layer cap +1, layer duration about x1.25 and per-layer slow about x1.2, at silk speed about x0.85, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +12 ticks - thicker and longer, but slower and costlier.
worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.option.off: Thin web: the silk flies faster with a shorter wind-up and cooldown, at the cost of fewer and shorter layers.
worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, spends %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.growth.0: At level %1$s the first layer lasts %2$s and the cooldown falls to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.preference.t: On: layer cap +1, layer duration about x1.25 and per-layer slow about x1.2, at silk speed about x0.85, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +12 ticks - wrapping a target down layer by layer, slower and costlier. Off (thin web): the silk flies faster with a shorter wind-up and cooldown, at the cost of fewer and shorter layers.
worldcombat.skill.spiderweb.preference.a: The companion only considers a web on a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher lets it open from farther.
On: a target already wrapped but below the cap keeps getting layers - more layers move less; off: only targets with no web at all are webbed.
On: a fleeing target scores one tier higher - a layer of silk sticks to its feet; off: ranked as an ordinary control move.
On: do not web a target carrying burn - flame burns the fresh silk away and wastes the cast; off: web it anyway.
When on, the companion may leave its post to web a target even under a hold order.
world_combat.move.spiderweb.text.wrap: Wrapped in %1$s layer(s) of silk (%2$s s)
